$comment: 由 @a2ui/react 的 renderMap 反推生成：只保留当前 renderer 实际消费的字段。协议基线为 A2UI v0.8，并扩展了 Button.action.localDataModelUpdate 本地更新能力。

text.description: The text content to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g., '/doc/title').

usageHint.description: A hint for the base text style. One of: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, caption, body.

url.description: The URL of the image to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/thumbnail/url').

altText.description: The alt text for the image. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/thumbnail/altText').

fit.description: Specifies how the image should be resized to fit its container. This corresponds to the CSS 'object-fit' property.

usageHint.description: A hint for the image size and style.

name.description: The name of the icon to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/form/submit').

url.description: The URL of the video to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/video/url').
The URL of the audio to be played. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/song/url').

description.description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/song/title').

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. 'componentId' is the component to use as a template, and 'dataBinding' is the path to the map of components in the data model.

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. 'componentId' is the component to use as a template, and 'dataBinding' is the path to the map of components in the data model.

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. 'componentId' is the component to use as a template, and 'dataBinding' is the path to the map of components in the data model.

direction.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis.

child.description: The ID of the component to be rendered inside the card.

tabItems.description: An array of objects, where each object defines a tab with a title and a child component.

title.description: The tab title. Defines the value as either a literal value or a path to data model value (e.g. '/options/title').

entryPointChild.description: The ID of the component that opens the modal when interacted with (e.g., a button).

contentChild.description: The ID of the component to be displayed inside the modal.

child.description: The ID of the component to display in the button, typically a Text component.

primary.description: Indicates if this button should be styled as the primary action.

action.description: The action dispatched when the button is clicked. If 'localDataModelUpdate' is present, the renderer applies it to the data model locally; otherwise only data-action is rendered.

localDataModelUpdate.description: A dataModelUpdate-shaped payload applied locally on click. It must target the current surface.

surfaceId.description: Target surface id; must match the button's surface.

path.description: Base data model path, e.g. '/demo'. Defaults to the root path.

label.description: The text to display next to the checkbox. Defines the value as either a literal value or a path to data model ('path', e.g. '/option/label').

value.description: The current state of the checkbox. This can be a literal boolean ('literalBoolean') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/filter/open').

label.description: The text label for the input field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name').

text.description: The value of the text field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name').

textFieldType.description: The type of input field to display.

validationRegexp.description: A regular expression used for client-side validation of the input. This renderer only uses it for visual feedback.

value.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. This can be a literal string ('literalString') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/dob').

enableDate.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

enableTime.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

selections.description: The currently selected values for the component. This can be a literal array of strings or a path to an array in the data model ('path', e.g. '/hotel/options').

options.description: An array of available options for the user to choose from.

label.description: The text to display for this option. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model (e.g. '/option/label').

value.description: The value to be associated with this option when selected.

variant.description: The display style of the component.

label.description: The label for the slider. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path').

value.description: The current value of the slider. This can be a literal number ('literalNumber') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/restaurant/cost').

minValue.description: The minimum value of the slider.

maxValue.description: The maximum value of the slider.

limitations: 所有表单控件均为只读（CheckBox / TextField / DateTimeInput / MultipleChoice / Slider），暂不触发 updateModel。
Button.action.localDataModelUpdate 在本地写入当前 surface 的 dataModelMap；action.context 未解析，server action 仅保留 data-action、不派发 userAction。
MultipleChoice.maxAllowedSelections 与 filterable 未实现。
Tabs 与 Modal 为只读展示，无切换/弹窗交互。
组件节点尚未向 DOM 输出稳定 id，暂不支持按元素定位。
